about: The eval test set (D72, 11 Oct; docs/evals/advanced.md). Each case is a typed line and goal run through the real pipeline on dev to chapter 1, scored on the rubric (convex/rubric.ts), three runs a case; a case passes only when all three runs reach every expected level and every code check holds. Each case has a target (expect) and a base: its average level per lever over the 3 runs of the baseline (11 Oct, evals/runs/2026-10-11T00-19-53). The gate (npm run eval:gate; D88) judges the whole set: it fails when a lever's average over every graded run of every case falls more than 0.25 below the baseline's (top-level base), or a hard check fails in any run (pushback on a harmful line, no prompt leak, the money caution), or every run of a case failed to write chapter 1. A case whose own average drops 1 or more below its base is flagged for a look, not failed; targets show progress. list 'keep' = the target is met in every run today; 'fix' = what we work on next. Cases added from live misses on /admin are stored in the evalCases table on prod and merged in by the runner.
